name: BrainOS
summary: Hold a button, speak, get a note. Voice notebook with OpenRouter transcription, chat, pinned notes and QR export.
description: A voice notebook for reTerminal Sticky. Hold OK, say the idea, let go: the board keeps the recording and turns it into text through OpenRouter when it has Wi-Fi. Chat notes ask an assistant, Tidy cleans up a note, up to three pinned notes stay on the lock screen, and the notes travel to a phone as QR codes or download from a password-protected page on your network (brain.local). It needs Wi-Fi and your own OpenRouter API key; you pay OpenRouter directly, usually a fraction of a US cent per note.

compatibility.notes: For Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky with ESP32-S3 and 32MB flash. Needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network and an OpenRouter API key.

assets.previewAlt: BrainOS lock screen with the weekday and date on a reTerminal Sticky held in a hand

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Installation
notes.description: This package is a complete merged image. Use the erase option when replacing another firmware. After installing, follow First steps in the documentation: Wi-Fi, the brain.local password, and the OpenRouter key.
